The robot segment could be reduced to a single shot, as multiple shots of the robot moving might feel repetitive.
The nighttime cityscape shot is aesthetically pleasing but could be shortened to maintain a sense of momentum.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This is my first expedience at such a big scale. It really feels like you are experiencing
the future where the rules are necessarily written.
You will find people who can scale an idea which was not possible five minutes ago. I think
they are light bulb moments every hour. Every person that is present here is a special,
has a message, has a mission.
There are many, many young people here experimenting with different things.
Taking people all, you know, within different stages of their life, the young scientists,
the young global leaders, the global shapers, and connecting them.
Your whole being kind of goes up a notch. The atmosphere makes everybody really speak from
the heart. Before you know it, somehow you get caught up and you are doing the same.
It is very rare that people from all walks of life will be able to come together to be
breathed by some of the best scientists, scholars, the technicians, and understand the nuances
about all of these topics all at one time.
It is a place to learn a lot and you exchange a lot. People here are really open to listen
and to fight the connection because you can connect to people who are really different
from you and learn together.
My lab and I have fallen into the forefront of the Ebola crisis and it was very difficult
within the context of Ebola outbreak to say I am going to come here. The kinds of meetings
that I have been able to have the level of the individuals exceeded my expectations.
All the organizations might be a business, a social organization, a government. We need
to collaborate with creative thinking, the technical thinking, the entrepreneurial thinking.
Social entrepreneurs like me, you have a lot of expertise which we can share with the
corporate world.
What is entrepreneurial disruption? Which industries are facing it in the next 15 years?
It is not just about experiencing what will change in the future. It is about experiencing
what we have in the present but we want to preserve in the future.
When you include the voices of other artists, when adds so much to the discussion.
There is sometimes a disjunction between knowledge and experience. When you open your mind
up to a kind of contemplative space, that is a brilliant portal for problem solving.
In the last three days I have seen more exciting initiatives than I have in the last three
years.
A lot need to be done to translate the inter-reality and to eventually make a difference.
